documentation.title: Direct Database Query
documentation.standard: Direct database queries using WPDB class methods should be avoided. WordPress database abstraction layers handle caching, data integrity, and firing of hooks, which direct queries bypass.

code.title: Valid: Using WP_Query to retrieve data.
Invalid: Using a direct query to retrieve data.

documentation.standard: When a direct database call is necessary, it should be paired with caching. For read queries, this avoids running expensive queries multiple times. For write queries, invalidating relevant caches prevents stale data.

code.title: Valid: Direct query results are cached and retrieved from cache when available.
Valid: Cache is invalidated after a write query.
Invalid: Write query without cache invalidation.

documentation.standard: Altering the database schema using ALTER, CREATE, or DROP statements is discouraged, as it can break WordPress core, plugins, or themes that depend on the existing schema.

code.title: Valid: Not altering the database schema.
